system.biography:
Alleged son of the Unconquered Sun, divine liaison between the Most High and his Chosen. Appears as a bronze-skinned young man with the sculpted thews of a gladiator, dressing like a monk in a red coat. Carries Fire Dragon's Whisker (red bamboo serpent-sting staff). Blank white eyes; sunlight blazes from his face when angered.

Source: Glories of the Most High: The Unconquered Sun.
